request_schema.description:
A write request: one or more commands applied as a single transaction (ADR-0006).

JSON may also use the single-command shorthand `{"command": ..., "args": ...}` with
the same envelope fields.

actor.description: Who makes the change: `human`, or `agent:<client name>`.

allow_destructive.description: Permit destructive operations such as removing clips from the primary video track.

at_ms.description: Commit time in milliseconds since the Unix epoch, supplied by the host.

commands.description: Commands to apply atomically, in order.

dry_run.description: Validate and report changes without committing.

expected_revision.description: Fail with `fosscut.revision.conflict` unless the project is at this revision.

reason.description: Why the change is made, recorded in the operation log.
